props.name: layout
props.doc: Presentation layout — `default` (full-width text) or `quote` (accent blockquote).

props.name: quoteAccentColor
props.doc: Quote-layout left-border accent. `'accent'`/absent falls back to the `--color-accent` token; any other value is applied verbatim as a CSS color. Ignored outside the `quote` layout.

props.name: sectionSpacing
props.doc: Vertical section padding preset. Defaults to `medium`.

props.name: textColor
props.doc: Body text color. `'auto'`/absent falls back to the `--color-fg` token; any other value is applied verbatim as a CSS color.

components.name: RowActionsMenu
components.summary: A stateless-per-render kebab menu. Owns only its own open/closed toggle + focus management; every action is delegated to the caller's `onSelect`. Domain-ignorant: it never sees a tenant or capability.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible label for the kebab trigger — localized by the caller (default `Acciones`).

components.name: SectionStack
components.summary: The IR-driven paginated Section Stack carousel. Pure of domain — same `items` render the same view; the only state is UI-local (which slide is active + whether the viewer took manual control), which is legitimate view state, not domain/effect state (RFC-017).

props.name: items
props.doc: The slides, in the order the IR declares them. Empty → the component renders nothing.

props.name: autoPlayMs
props.doc: Auto-rotate interval in ms (canon §3: 8–10s, slower than tabs). `0`/omitted disables auto-play — the component is then a pure manual carousel (deterministic for golden tests).

components.name: SectionWrapper
components.summary: The standard landing section frame. Renders a `<section>` with relative positioning, a centered max-width inner container, and auto-wired scroll reveal.

props.name: children
props.doc: Section content (the `T1<Section>` body). Tag children `data-animate` to scroll-reveal them.

props.name: background
props.doc: Section background. Default `white`. `dark` applies the §8 mesh gradient (never flat).

props.name: container
props.doc: Inner container max width. Default `main` (`1018px`).

props.name: decoration
props.doc: Absolutely-positioned decoration (GlowBlob, dot pattern) — rendered behind content (z-0).

props.name: id
props.doc: Stable section anchor id (matches the `SectionSlice.id` of the owning `T1<Section>`).

props.name: paddingY
props.doc: Vertical padding token-multiple; canon minimum is `py-20 tablet:py-28` → default `96px`.

components.name: Select
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled native `<select>`. Associated to its `label` by id, keyboard- and screen-reader-accessible by default. The value is controlled — `value` in, `onChange(next)` out.

props.name: onChange
props.doc: Called with the next option value on change. Behavior is fully delegated.

props.name: options
props.doc: The options to render, as typed `{ value, label }` pairs (no bare-string shorthand — explicit).

props.name: value
props.doc: Controlled selected value — the caller owns it; this component holds no state.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: When `true`, the native `disabled` attr removes it from the tab order and blocks selection.

props.name: id
props.doc: Explicit element id. Falls back to a slug of `label` so the `<label htmlFor>` stays wired.

props.name: label
props.doc: Visible label, associated to the control by `id`/`htmlFor`. Strongly recommended for an accessible name; when omitted, supply `id` + an external `<label>` or an `aria-label` via the caller.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Placeholder rendered as a disabled empty-value option (shown when `value === ''`).

components.name: SurfaceCard
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled dashboard card. Renders a bordered white surface; when `title` is set it renders a `<header>` with a real heading (level `headingLevel`) plus the optional `headerAction`, then the `children` body, then the optional right-aligned `footer`. All styling flows from the DASHBOARD brand tokens; all behavior is delegated to the nodes the caller passes.

props.name: children
props.doc: The card body.

props.name: elevated
props.doc: Apply the dashboard system card shadow (`--shadow-dash-card`). Defaults to `true`.

props.name: footer
props.doc: Optional footer slot for actions — laid out as a right-aligned row (a rendered node).

props.name: headerAction
props.doc: Optional trailing header slot, aligned to the right of the title (e.g. an edit link or menu).

props.name: headingLevel
props.doc: Heading level for {@link title}. Defaults to `3`.

props.name: padding
props.doc: Inner padding. Defaults to `lg` (24px).

props.name: size
props.doc: Corner radius. Defaults to `md` (10px).

props.name: title
props.doc: Optional header title. When present, rendered as a heading (`headingLevel`, default `h3`).

components.name: Switch
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled switch. Renders a native `<button role="switch" aria-checked>` (focusable, Enter/Space-operable for free) beside an optional label. The state is controlled — `checked` in, `onCheckedChange(next)` out. Provide `label` (string) or `ariaLabel` for the accessible name.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Controlled on/off state — the caller owns it; this component holds no state.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.doc: Called with the next boolean on activation (click or Enter/Space). Behavior is delegated.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Explicit accessible name for the switch, overriding the string `label`. Required when neither is a string.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: When `true`, the native `disabled` attr removes it from the tab order and blocks toggling.

props.name: label
props.doc: Visible label text beside the toggle. Also drives the accessible name via `aria-label`.

components.name: T1FinalCTA
components.summary: `<T1FinalCTA>` — renders the human-avatars final CTA from its IR slice. Stateless and total: an empty `avatars` array renders the enterprise/counter-style close (canon `LANDING-SECTIONS.md:1316`) without the row; a missing `description` simply omits the line. Routing is delegated via `onAction`.

props.name: onAction
props.doc: Invoked with the activated CTA so the host owns navigation (the section never embeds a route literal).

components.name: T1LifestyleCards
components.summary: The lifestyle section — variant *3 human-photo profiles*. Renders exactly `slice.cards` in their IR-declared order; an empty `cards` array renders the heading with no grid (a total function — the section never invents a card the slice did not declare).

props.name: slice
props.doc: The projected IR slice. All rendered content comes from here.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled tab bar implementing the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern. Selection is controlled — `activeId` in, `onSelect(nextId)` out. Click, Arrow-Left/Right, and Home/End all move selection via the callback; when tabs carry `content`, the active panel renders below, labelled by its header.

props.name: activeId
props.doc: Controlled active tab id — the caller owns it; this component holds no state.

props.name: onSelect
props.doc: Called with the next tab id on click or keyboard navigation. Behavior is fully delegated.

props.name: tabs
props.doc: The tabs to render, in order.

components.name: Tag
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled chip. Renders a `<span>`; when `onRemove` is provided it appends an accessible remove `<button>` (`aria-label={removeLabel}`). All behavior is delegated via props.

props.name: onRemove
props.doc: When provided, renders an accessible remove (`×`) control and calls this on activation.

props.name: removeLabel
props.doc: Accessible label for the remove control — localized by the caller (default `Quitar`).

props.name: selected
props.doc: Selected chips use the brand-red register; the default is neutral gray.

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled multi-line text field. Renders a native `<textarea>` (accessible + keyboard-operable by default), associated to its `label` by id. The value is controlled — `value` in, `onChange(next)` out — and all state edges (`error`/`success`/`disabled`/`readOnly`) are pure functions of props.

props.name: onChange
props.doc: Called with the next raw string on every keystroke. Behavior is fully delegated.

props.name: value
props.doc: Controlled value — the caller owns the text; this component holds no state.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: When `true`, the native `disabled` attr removes it from the tab order and blocks input.

props.name: helper
props.doc: Small helper/error text under the field; recolored to the error register when `state="error"`. Wired to the field via `aria-describedby` (and announced as `role="alert"` in the error state) so assistive tech reads the *message*, not just the generic invalid flag — provided the field has an `id` (from `label` or `id`); without one, the caller owns the association.

props.name: id
props.doc: Explicit element id. Falls back to a slug of `label` so the `<label htmlFor>` stays wired.

props.name: label
props.doc: Visible label, associated to the control by `id`/`htmlFor`. Strongly recommended for an accessible name; when omitted, supply `id` + an external `<label>` or an `aria-label` via the caller.

props.name: readOnly
props.doc: When `true`, the field shows its value but is not editable (native `readOnly`).

props.name: rows
props.doc: Visible row count (native `rows`). Defaults to `4`.

props.name: state
props.doc: Validation register. Defaults to `default`.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: A single toast. Stateless w.r.t. its queue position (the {@link ToastProvider} owns the stack); it owns only its own enter transition + auto-dismiss timer. Renders `<Alert>` as the live region and, when `action` is present, a Nexus `<Button>` beneath the message.

props.name: message
props.doc: The toast body — user-facing copy (localized by the caller).

props.name: action
props.doc: Optional call-to-action; its presence pins the toast open (no auto-dismiss).

props.name: dismissLabel
props.doc: Accessible label for the dismiss control — localized by the caller (default `Cerrar`).

props.name: durationMs
props.doc: Auto-dismiss override in ms. `undefined` ⇒ the severity/action default; a positive number ⇒ that timeout; `null`/`0`/negative ⇒ persist. See {@link resolveToastDurationMs}.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Optional leading icon element, tinted to the variant's border color (forwarded to `<Alert>`).

props.name: onDismiss
props.doc: Dismiss handler — wires the `×` control, `Escape`, and auto-dismiss.

props.name: severity
props.doc: The semantic severity. Defaults to `info`.

props.name: title
props.doc: Optional bold title above the message (forwarded to `<Alert>`).

components.name: ToastProvider
components.summary: Provide the toast API to a subtree and render the portaled viewport. State (the live stack) lives here; individual {@link Toast}s own their own timer + transition.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible label for the toast viewport region — localized by the caller (default `Notificaciones`).

props.name: maxVisible
props.doc: Max toasts visible at once; excess is dropped FIFO (oldest first). Defaults to 3.

components.name: chatKit.Accordion
components.summary: `<Accordion>` — single collapsible panel (PRJ-009 W-S8 C-2′).

props.name: children
props.doc: Body content — shown only when open.

props.name: summary
props.doc: Summary row content — shown whether open or closed.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.doc: Uncontrolled initial open state. Ignored if `open` is provided.

props.name: leading
props.doc: Optional icon/badge shown to the left of the summary.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.doc: Fires when the user toggles the disclosure.

props.name: open
props.doc: Controlled open state. Pair with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: size
props.doc: `sm` matches compact inline rows; `base` matches standalone sections.

props.name: variant
props.doc: `base` = bordered card with subtle surface. `subtle` = dashed border, no background — good for muted metadata like reasoning traces.

components.name: chatKit.Card
components.summary: `<Card>` — bordered surface container with optional header/footer (PRJ-009 W-S8 C-2′).

props.name: elevated
props.doc: Raise the shadow one step to emphasise the card.

props.name: noBodyPadding
props.doc: Remove default inner padding from the body slot.

props.name: onClick
props.doc: Click handler — if provided, the card renders with `role="button"`.

components.name: chatKit.ContentArea
components.summary: `<ContentArea>` — padded container for primary page content (PRJ-009 W-S8 C-2′).

props.name: maxWidth
props.doc: Max content width. Default: `'lg'`.

props.name: noPadding
props.doc: If true, removes inner padding (default false — padding applied).

props.name: role
props.doc: DOM role override. Default: `'main'`.

components.name: chatKit.StatusPill
components.summary: `<StatusPill>` — labeled pill with idle / pending / success / error state (PRJ-009 W-S8 C-2′).

props.name: leading
props.doc: Optional element rendered before the label. Ignored when `state="pending"` (spinner takes its slot).

PageSlot.declaration: export type PageSlot = number | typeof PAGE_ELLIPSIS;
